notes: The statistics of suicides by age revealed that the maximum
suicides were committed by persons belonging to the age group bet-
ween 18 to 30 years, being 44.8 per cent of the total. 30.2 per cent
of the total suicides were committed by persons belonging to age
group between 30 to 50 years. Persons below 18 years of age who
commitied suicide comprised 16.3 per cent and persons above 450
years of age comprised 8.7 per cent of the total suicides
during 1974. The pattern of suicides according to age was almost
the same as for the country as a whole. The percentage of male in
